name: Chongqing Construction Engineering Group Corporation Limited
summary: Chongqing Construction Engineering Group Corporation Limited engages in infrastructure construction and building construction engineering activities in China. The company is involved in the construction, development, and investment of highways and highway subgrades, pavements, bridges, water conservancy, ports, tunnels, etc.; and construction of public and civil buildings, electromechanical installation engineering, building decoration, etc. It also provides engineering design, steel structures and building materials, franchising, and logistics distribution services, as well as technical consulting and technical services of construction machinery and equipment.
